title: Grade 5 French — Tue, Jun 02
description: La maison — Day 2 of 5: Furniture and objects (les meubles et les objets)
subject: french

questions.question: What does 'le lit' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Le lit' = the bed. 'Je dors dans mon lit.' = I sleep in my bed.

questions.question: What does 'la table' mean?
questions.explanation: 'La table' = the table. 'On mange à table.' = We eat at the table.

questions.question: What does 'la chaise' mean?
questions.explanation: 'La chaise' = the chair. 'Assieds-toi sur la chaise.' = Sit on the chair.

questions.question: What does 'le canapé' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Le canapé' = the sofa / couch. 'Je m'assois sur le canapé.' = I sit on the sofa.

questions.question: What does 'la fenêtre' mean?
questions.explanation: 'La fenêtre' = the window. 'J'ouvre la fenêtre.' = I open the window.

questions.question: What does 'la porte' mean?
questions.explanation: 'La porte' = the door. 'Ferme la porte.' = Close the door.

questions.question: What does 'l'armoire' mean?
questions.explanation: 'L'armoire' (f.) = the wardrobe / cupboard. 'Mes vêtements sont dans l'armoire.' = My clothes are in the wardrobe.

questions.question: What does 'le bureau' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Le bureau' = the desk (it can also mean 'the office'). 'Je fais mes devoirs sur le bureau.' = I do my homework at the desk.

questions.question: What does 'le réfrigérateur' (le frigo) mean?
questions.explanation: 'Le réfrigérateur' (short: 'le frigo') = the fridge. It is in the cuisine.

questions.question: What does 'la lampe' mean?
questions.explanation: 'La lampe' = the lamp. 'J'allume la lampe.' = I turn on the lamp.

questions.question: What does 'le tapis' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Le tapis' = the rug / carpet. 'Le tapis est sur le sol.' = The rug is on the floor.

questions.question: What does 'le mur' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Le mur' = the wall. 'Le tableau est sur le mur.' = The painting is on the wall.

questions.question: Which item belongs in 'la chambre' (bedroom)?
questions.explanation: 'Le lit' (the bed) belongs in the bedroom. The fridge (frigo), bathtub (baignoire) and cooker (cuisinière) belong elsewhere.

questions.question: What does 'le rideau' mean?
questions.explanation: 'Le rideau' = the curtain. 'Les rideaux sont devant la fenêtre.' = The curtains are in front of the window.

questions.question: Which item would you find in 'la salle de bains'?
questions.explanation: 'La baignoire' (the bathtub) belongs in the bathroom.
